papers.title: Auditing Biomedical Literature with Blinded AI Peer Review: Where Peer Review Works, Where It Fails, and How to Strengthen It
papers.translated_title: 以盲法人工智能同行评审审计生物医学文献：同行评审在何处有效、在何处失效，以及如何加强它
papers.author: Kosakovsky Pond, S. L.
papers.summary: Biomedical publishing has grown more than elevenfold since 1991, outstripping human peer review. Unblinded language models cannot audit this literature objectively because they recognize famous authors and journals from training memory. We built BARS (Blinded AI Review System), an automated referee that strips titles, author names, institutions, journal headers, and dates before grading full-text manuscripts on a 10-point scale covering methods, evidence, biology, and reproducibility. We used BARS to generate 1,874 blind reviews across 1,714 unique papers. BARS passed 100% of verified sound controls, caught 77% to 91% of internally flawed papers, eliminated a +0.35-point prestige boost, and more than doubled human referee consistency. Across 320 recent open-access articles (2020-2025) from eight fields, 54% failed on core scientific rigor (<5.0/10; 41% excluding megajournals). Revision at selective journals improved preprints more than twice as much as revision at commercial megajournals (+0.62 vs. +0.30 points; baseline-adjusted p = 0.033), and BARS recalled 98% of unresolved human referee critiques across 100 open-review papers. Across 915 date-blinded papers from 1991 to 2025, average scores fell from 7.6/10 to 5.8/10 as megajournals and template database studies expanded. Blinded self-audits of 238 papers by two senior authors -- and of this manuscript itself -- caught real statistical, control, and table errors in our own work. At four cents per paper, BARS offers a practical quality check for authors, journals, and readers (https://veg.github.io/BARS/).
papers.translated_summary: 自1991年以来，生物医学出版量增长了十一倍以上，已超出人类同行评审的承载能力。非盲语言模型无法客观审查这些文献，因为它们能从训练记忆中识别出著名作者和期刊。我们构建了BARS（盲审人工智能评审系统），这是一个自动化审稿工具，在按10分制对全文稿件进行评分之前，会剥离标题、作者姓名、机构、期刊页眉和日期，评分涵盖方法、证据、生物学和可重复性。我们使用BARS对1,714篇独特论文生成了1,874份盲审意见。BARS通过了100%的经验证可靠对照，捕获了77%至91%的存在内部缺陷的论文，消除了+0.35分的声望加成，并使人类审稿人的一致性提高了一倍以上。在来自八个领域的320篇近期开放获取文章（2020-2025年）中，54%在核心科学严谨性上不合格（<5.0/10；排除巨型期刊后为41%）。选择性期刊的修订对预印本的改善程度是商业巨型期刊修订的两倍以上（+0.62对+0.30分；基线调整后p = 0.033），并且BARS在100篇开放评审论文中召回了98%的未解决人类审稿人批评意见。在1991年至2025年的915篇日期盲审论文中，随着巨型期刊和模板数据库研究的扩张，平均得分从7.6/10降至5.8/10。两位资深作者对238篇论文进行的盲审自审——以及对本稿件本身的自审——在我们自己的工作中发现了真实的统计、对照和表格错误。每篇论文四美分的成本下，BARS为作者、期刊和读者提供了一种实用的质量检查工具（https://veg.github.io/BARS/）。

papers.title: Conserved synaptic modifications by humanized tau through diverse isoform- and mutation-specific intracellular interactions
papers.translated_title: 人源化tau通过多种异构体和突变特异性的细胞内相互作用保守的突触修饰
papers.author: Nickerson, E.
papers.summary: Mutations in the microtubule-binding protein tau are considered causal for a diverse group of neurodegenerative diseases collectively referred to as primary tauopathies. Specific tauopathies are associated with different mutations, distinct tau isoforms, manifest in unique cellular and circuit-wide patterns of degeneration, and present with specific clinical symptoms and trajectories. The mechanisms that link variations in the primary tau protein structure to distinct forms of neural circuit dysfunction remain largely unknown. Here, we created an orthogonal viral resource to systematically examine the impact of expressing humanized tau isoforms harboring different disease-relevant mutations in excitatory pyramidal cells from the mouse prelimbic cortex. We used these reagents to show that expression of mutant humanized tau (hTau) as either of two isoforms produced very similar patterns of circuit-specific synaptic disconnection on cortical projection neurons. However, mass spectrometry revealed that the interactomes of these different tau species varied markedly as functions of isoform, mutation, and subcellular location. We validated the functional relevance of increased hTau interactions with mitochondrial proteins in induced neurons differentiated from Ngn2-iPSCs expressing different hTau constructs. These results suggest different disease-relevant hTau proteins likely use distinct mechanisms to drive a highly stereotyped form of synapse loss in cortical neurons.
papers.translated_summary: 微管结合蛋白tau的突变被认为是导致一组统称为原发性tau蛋白病的多种神经退行性疾病的病因。特定的tau蛋白病与不同的突变、不同的tau异构体相关，表现为独特的细胞和环路层面的退化模式，并呈现出特定的临床症状和病程轨迹。将初级tau蛋白结构变异与不同形式的神经环路功能障碍联系起来的机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。在此，我们构建了一种正交病毒资源，以系统性地检测在小鼠前边缘皮层兴奋性锥体细胞中表达携带不同疾病相关突变的人源化tau异构体的影响。我们利用这些试剂证明，表达突变型人源化tau（hTau）的两种异构体中的任何一种，均可在皮层投射神经元上产生非常相似的环路特异性突触断开模式。然而，质谱分析揭示，这些不同tau物种的相互作用组因异构体、突变和亚细胞定位的不同而存在显著差异。我们在由表达不同hTau构建体的Ngn2-iPSCs分化而来的诱导神经元中，验证了hTau与线粒体蛋白相互作用增加的功能相关性。这些结果表明，不同的疾病相关hTau蛋白可能利用不同的机制来驱动皮层神经元中一种高度刻板化的突触丢失形式。

papers.title: Serial dependence carries the action that produced the previous report
papers.translated_title: 序列依赖性承载了产生前一报告的动作
papers.author: Qu, C.
papers.summary: Serial dependence pulls current judgments toward the recent past, but what is carried forward is debated: the previous stimulus, the previous decision, or something about the report itself. Three magnitude-reproduction experiments separated these sources. Participants viewed dot arrays that varied independently in duration and numerosity, then reproduced the cued dimension by holding a key while a display accumulated, so that both magnitudes were produced through the same action. A response-history model partitioned the attraction into previous-stimulus and previous-response paths. The previous response predicted cross-dimensional attraction after controlling for the previous and current stimuli: a numerosity report biased the next duration judgment and vice versa (Experiment 1), also when each task used its own response key (Experiment 2). A task switch weakened this carryover without abolishing it. Experiment 3 randomized, trial by trial, whether a reported number required a long or a short key hold. The influence of a previous number on the next duration judgment changed with this mapping, showing that reported value alone did not account for carryover. Conventional stimulus-based measures showed none of this cross-task history. Serial dependence can therefore carry the trace of the action through which a previous judgment was expressed, bounded but not gated by task context.
papers.translated_summary: 序列依赖会将当前判断拉向近期过去，但被延续下来的是什么仍有争议：是先前的刺激、先前的决定，还是与报告本身有关的某些内容。三项量级再现实验分离了这些来源。参与者观看在时距和数量上独立变化的点阵，然后通过按住按键同时让显示累积来再现被提示的维度，因此两种量级都通过同一动作产生。一个反应历史模型将吸引效应分解为先前刺激路径和先前反应路径。在控制先前和当前刺激后，先前反应预测了跨维度吸引：数量报告会偏向随后的时距判断，反之亦然（实验1），当每个任务使用各自的反应键时也是如此（实验2）。任务切换削弱了这种延续效应，但未将其消除。实验3逐试次随机化所报告数字需要长按键还是短按键。先前数字对随后时距判断的影响随这一映射而变化，表明仅报告值本身不能解释延续效应。传统的基于刺激的测量未显示出这种跨任务历史。因此，序列依赖可以携带先前判断借以表达的动作痕迹，受任务情境约束但不受其门控。

papers.title: Mitochondria-Coupled Hitchhiking Drives Vimentin Intermediate Filament Transport
papers.translated_title: 线粒体偶联的搭便车驱动波形蛋白中间丝运输
papers.author: Renganathan, B.
papers.summary: Vimentin intermediate filaments (VIFs) undergo active microtubule-dependent transport throughout the cell, with trajectories resembling those of motor-driven organelles, yet our recent work showed that only a small subset of VIFs lies close to microtubules. How VIFs engage the microtubule-based transport machinery, and whether additional transport routes contribute, remain unresolved. We hypothesized that VIFs move indirectly, by hitchhiking on motile organelles, and tested this using mitochondria. Live imaging showed mitochondria and adjacent VIFs moving together, and volume electron microscopy revealed VIFs closely following mitochondrial surfaces at sites distinct from microtubule contacts. Depleting the mitochondrial motor adaptor TRAK1 to inhibit anterograde mitochondrial transport shifted both mitochondria and VIFs toward the nucleus. Driving mitochondria toward the cell periphery with a tailless kinesin-1 in cells lacking endogenous kinesin-1, or toward the cell center with a minus-end-directed motor, redistributed a subset of VIFs in the same direction. Thus, VIF transport to a large extend is accomplished by hitchhiking on motile mitochondria.
papers.translated_summary: 波形蛋白中间丝（VIFs）在整个细胞中经历活跃的微管依赖性运输，其运动轨迹类似于马达驱动的细胞器，但我们最近的研究表明，只有一小部分VIFs靠近微管。VIFs如何参与基于微管的运输机制，以及是否有其他运输途径参与其中，仍未得到解决。我们假设VIFs通过搭便车在运动细胞器上间接移动，并利用线粒体对此进行了验证。活细胞成像显示线粒体与相邻的VIFs一起移动，体积电子显微镜显示VIFs在不同于微管接触位点的位置紧密跟随线粒体表面。敲低线粒体马达衔接蛋白TRAK1以抑制顺行线粒体运输，使线粒体和VIFs均向细胞核方向移动。在缺乏内源性驱动蛋白-1的细胞中，用无尾部驱动蛋白-1将线粒体驱向细胞外周，或用向微管负极方向运动的马达将线粒体驱向细胞中心，可使一部分VIFs向相同方向重新分布。因此，VIFs的运输在很大程度上是通过搭便车在运动线粒体上完成的。

papers.title: Sex-specific bone marrow populations regulate skeletal phenotype and identify CD74-marked osteoclast precursor subsets
papers.translated_title: 性别特异性骨髓细胞群体调控骨骼表型并鉴定CD74标记的破骨细胞前体亚群
papers.author: Koroth, J.
papers.summary: While there are clear differences in bone accrual and maintenance between men and women due to hormonal regulation, the potential cell-intrinsic factors governing this difference are poorly understood. To investigate this, we performed bone marrow transplantation assays using male or female bone marrow transplantation into male hosts. Micro-CT analyses of lethally irradiated 8-week-old male mice transplanted with female bone marrow exhibited increased vertebral body trabecular and cortical bone mass. To identify cell types mediating these effects, we performed comparative single cell sequencing analyses and identified several CD11B+CD74+ myeloid cell clusters. Male donor BM chimeric mice had a higher proportion of Cd74-expressing clusters compared to female donor BM chimeric mice. We confirmed that males have greater numbers of bone marrow-resident CD11B+CD74+ cells under physiological conditions. Elevated expression of X-linked genes Tlr7 and Kdm6a marked a population of CD11B+CD74+ cells. Lastly, we show that female CD11B+CD74+ cells exhibit diminished osteoclastogenesis. These findings demonstrate that male and female bone marrow-resident cells have cell-intrinsic differences that regulate bone mass and that CD74 marks a subset of osteoclast precursor-enriched myeloid populations.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管由于激素调节，男性和女性在骨量获得和维持方面存在明显差异，但调控这种差异的潜在细胞内在因素仍知之甚少。为了研究这一问题，我们进行了骨髓移植实验，将雄性或不性骨髓移植到雄性宿主中。对接受致死剂量照射的8周龄雄性小鼠移植雌性骨髓后进行Micro-CT分析，显示椎体小梁骨和皮质骨量增加。为了确定介导这些效应的细胞类型，我们进行了比较单细胞测序分析，并鉴定出若干CD11B+CD74+髓系细胞簇。雄性供体骨髓嵌合小鼠相比雌性供体骨髓嵌合小鼠具有更高比例的表达Cd74的细胞簇。我们证实，在生理条件下雄性具有更多数量的骨髓驻留CD11B+CD74+细胞。X连锁基因Tlr7和Kdm6a的表达升高标记了一群CD11B+CD74+细胞。最后，我们证明雌性CD11B+CD74+细胞的破骨细胞生成能力减弱。这些发现表明，雄性和雌性骨髓驻留细胞具有调控骨量的细胞内在差异，且CD74标记了一个富含破骨细胞前体的髓系细胞亚群。

papers.title: PPI-Rescue: restoration of eye development via functional reconstitution of a transcription complex.
papers.translated_title: PPI-Rescue：通过转录复合物的功能性重建恢复眼睛发育。
papers.author: Jusic, N.
papers.summary: The activity of transcription factors (TFs) can be modulated through protein-protein interactions (PPIs) with cofactors which can serve to enhance, repress or alter the specificity of TF function. Current genetic and molecular approaches such as knockout and overexpression studies are likely to affect all possible activities of a TF, presenting a dilemma when attempting to parse out how TFs function within a cell. Hence, there is a need to devise a technique that will allow for mechanistic insight to be gained into the function(s) of discrete transcription complexes. Herein we report ''PPI-Rescue'', an approach that leverages bespoke mutations in TFs and the selective reconstitution of specific complexes to study the molecular properties and biological functions of discrete transcription complexes in vitro and in vivo. We demonstrate PPI-Rescue using the conserved Drosophila transcription factor Sine oculis (So) and cofactor Eyes Absent (Eya). To validate this approach, we engineered a missense mutation, So{Delta}Eya (C110S), that selectively abrogates PPI-Eya to show that PPI-Eya is necessary for the transcriptional activity of So in cultured cells and to promote eye formation in Drosophila. Using heterologous leucine zipper domains, we specifically reconstituted the So{Delta}Eya-Eya PPI and show that this complex is transcriptionally active in cells and can rescue eye development. PPI-Rescue was also used to restore transcriptional activity to So{Delta}PPI (V111E), an allele that mimics the human SIX1(V17E) allele associated with Branchio-Oto-Renal syndrome. PPI-Rescue thus represents an innovative approach to understanding the complex molecular logic of transcription complexes in both development and disease.
papers.translated_summary: 转录因子（TFs）的活性可以通过与辅因子的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）进行调节，这些辅因子能够增强、抑制或改变TF功能的特异性。当前的遗传学和分子学方法，如敲除和过表达研究，可能会影响TF所有可能的活动，这在试图解析TF在细胞中如何发挥功能时造成了困境。因此，需要设计一种技术，能够获得对离散转录复合物功能的机制性洞察。在此我们报道了“PPI-Rescue”，一种利用TF中的定制突变和特定复合物的选择性重建来研究离散转录复合物在体外和体内的分子特性和生物学功能的方法。我们使用保守的果蝇转录因子Sine oculis（So）和辅因子Eyes Absent（Eya）来展示PPI-Rescue。为验证该方法，我们设计了一个错义突变So{Delta}Eya（C110S），选择性消除PPI-Eya，以证明PPI-Eya对于So在培养细胞中的转录活性以及促进果蝇眼部形成是必需的。利用异源亮氨酸拉链结构域，我们特异性地重建了So{Delta}Eya-Eya PPI，并证明该复合物在细胞中具有转录活性，且能够挽救眼部发育。PPI-Rescue还被用于恢复So{Delta}PPI（V111E）的转录活性，该等位基因模拟了与Branchio-Oto-Renal综合征相关的人类SIX1(V17E)等位基因。因此，PPI-Rescue代表了一种创新方法，可用于理解发育和疾病中转录复合物的复杂分子逻辑。

papers.title: Habitat degradation destabilizes complex metacommunities by disrupting dispersal
papers.translated_title: 生境退化通过破坏扩散过程使复杂的集合群落失稳
papers.author: Sun, Y.
papers.summary: Habitat loss and fragmentation are rapidly reshaping ecosystems worldwide, yet their consequences for ecological stability remain unresolved. Classical theory, pioneered by Robert May, established rigorous criteria for stability; however, these apply to spatially well-mixed communities, limiting their relevance to habitat degradation. Here, we develop a metacommunity framework that integrates classical stability theory with spatial dynamics to determine how anthropogenic habitat degradation reshapes ecosystem stability. We show that metacommunities exhibit three distinct dynamical regimes following a perturbation (e.g., drought or forest fire): stable regime (perturbations decay and species persist), reactive regime (perturbations are transiently amplified, which increases extinction risk under repeated disturbances), and unstable regime (perturbations grow, causing extinctions even after a single disturbance). Dispersal fundamentally reshapes these stability transitions, converting unstable communities into reactive ones and reactive communities into stable ones. While homogeneous dispersal progressively stabilizes communities, heterogeneous dispersal maximizes stability at intermediate strengths. We further show that habitat loss and fragmentation can be comparably effective at driving species extinctions by shifting metacommunities from stable to reactive and ultimately unstable regimes, demonstrating that fragmentation per se can be as important as habitat loss. Our findings reveal that reactivity is both an early-warning signal of impending instability and a state of elevated extinction risk under recurrent disturbances. By linking stability transitions to changes in population persistence under nonlinear dynamics, our results bridge classical stability theory with spatial ecology and provide a general framework for predicting how ecological complexity and dispersal jointly govern both ecosystem stability and population persistence under habitat degradation.
papers.translated_summary: 栖息地丧失和破碎化正在迅速重塑全球生态系统，然而其对生态稳定性的后果仍未得到解决。由Robert May开创的经典理论建立了严格的稳定性判据；然而，这些判据适用于空间上充分混合的群落，限制了其与栖息地退化的相关性。在此，我们构建了一个集合群落框架，将经典稳定性理论与空间动力学相结合，以确定人为栖息地退化如何重塑生态系统稳定性。我们表明，集合群落在扰动（例如干旱或森林火灾）之后表现出三种不同的动力学 regime：稳定 regime（扰动衰减且物种持续存在）、反应性 regime（扰动被短暂放大，这在反复扰动下增加灭绝风险）以及不稳定 regime（扰动增长，即使在单次扰动后也导致灭绝）。扩散从根本上重塑了这些稳定性转变，将不稳定群落转化为反应性群落，将反应性群落转化为稳定群落。均质扩散逐步稳定群落，而异质扩散在中等强度下使稳定性最大化。我们进一步表明，栖息地丧失和破碎化在驱动物种灭绝方面可以具有相当的效果，其通过将集合群落从稳定 regime 转变为反应性 regime 并最终转变为不稳定 regime 来实现，这表明破碎化本身可以与栖息地丧失同等重要。我们的发现揭示，反应性既是即将发生不稳定的早期预警信号，也是在反复扰动下灭绝风险升高的状态。通过将稳定性转变与非线性动力学下种群持续性的变化联系起来，我们的结果将经典稳定性理论与空间生态学联系起来，并提供了一个通用框架，用于预测生态复杂性和扩散如何在栖息地退化下共同调控生态系统稳定性和种群持续性。

papers.title: Protein language models learn the underlying accessibility of mutations alongside protein fitness landscapes
papers.translated_title: 蛋白质语言模型在蛋白质适应度景观之外还学习了突变的内在可及性
papers.author: MacLean, O. A.
papers.summary: Protein language models (PLMs) score the effects of amino acid replacements as pseudo-probabilities, which are widely utilised to map protein fitness landscapes. However, because their training data relies on natural amino acid sequences, these models conflate protein structural constraints with nucleotide mutation biases and codon accessibility. Using the rapid emergence of the divergent influenza A H3N2 K lineage as a stress test, we investigate how base PLMs (ESM-2 and ESM-C) versus fine-tuned versions of these models capture mutational processes. We systematically implement a parameter sweep to explicitly couple (or decouple) empirical nucleotide mutational supply from PLM-assessed amino acid substitution pseudo-probabilities across evolutionary forecasting tasks. We find that base PLMs implicitly learn generic nucleotide-level mutational constraints, an effect strongly amplified by virus-specific fine-tuning. Incorporating explicit mutational accessibility significantly improves the binary prediction of observed amino acid changes. Conversely, when predicting the final circulating frequency of variants that have already emerged, adding mutational supply degrades performance, confirming that selection dominates post-emergence dynamics. Additionally, we perform amino-acid-level epistatic scanning to investigate protein structural constraints in the context of genetic background. This indicates the improbable antigenic substitution I160K is dependent on co-occurring S144N and N158D mutations in the H3N2 K lineage. Ultimately, current PLM pseudo-probabilities are a composite metric that conflates protein structural fitness with historical biases in mutational supply. Explicitly decoupling these independent evolutionary processes optimises predictive accuracy for real-world pathogen forecasting and isolates pure protein fitness for synthetic design pipelines.
papers.translated_summary: 蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）将氨基酸替换的效应评分为伪概率，这一方法被广泛用于绘制蛋白质适应度景观。然而，由于这些模型的训练数据依赖于天然氨基酸序列，它们将蛋白质结构约束与核苷酸突变偏倚及密码子可及性混为一谈。我们以甲型流感H3N2 K谱系的快速分化出现作为压力测试，研究基础PLMs（ESM-2和ESM-C）与这些模型的微调版本如何捕捉突变过程。我们系统实施参数扫描，在进化预测任务中显式地将经验核苷酸突变供给与PLM评估的氨基酸替换伪概率进行耦合（或解耦）。我们发现基础PLMs隐式学习了通用的核苷酸水平突变约束，而病毒特异性微调强烈放大了这一效应。纳入显式突变可及性显著改善了观察到的氨基酸变化的二分类预测。相反，在预测已出现变体的最终流行频率时，加入突变供给会降低性能，证实选择在出现后动态中占主导地位。此外，我们进行了氨基酸水平的上位性扫描，以研究遗传背景下的蛋白质结构约束。这表明不太可能的抗原性替换I160K依赖于H3N2 K谱系中同时发生的S144N和N158D突变。最终，当前的PLM伪概率是一个复合指标，将蛋白质结构适应度与突变供给的历史偏倚混为一谈。显式解耦这些独立的进化过程可优化真实世界病原体预测的预测准确性，并为合成设计流程分离出纯粹的蛋白质适应度。

papers.title: Novel Regulators of Sugar-dependent Food Consumption in Drosophila melanogaster
papers.translated_title: 果蝇中糖依赖性食物摄入的新型调控因子
papers.author: Opoola, M. A.
papers.summary: Diet and genetic background interact to influence food consumption, yet the genetic basis of diet-dependent feeding behavior remains poorly understood. Here, we used genome-wide association analysis (GWAS) to investigate the genetic regulation of sugar-dependent food consumption in Drosophila melanogaster. Food intake was quantified in 176 lines of the Drosophila Genetic Reference Panel (DGRP) using the Con-Ex (Consumption-Excretion) assay on low- and high-sugar foods. Flies showed compensatory feeding, consuming more low-sugar food than high-sugar food, and this behavior was largely maintained across genotypes. Additionally, the magnitude and overall consumption varied several-fold among lines, with broad-sense heritability of 0.53 to 0.66 across sexes and diets. Association analysis across six sex- and diet-specific phenotypes identified 161 variants mapping to 118 candidate genes, which shared almost no loci between dietary conditions, indicating that consumption on the two foods is largely under separate genetic control. RNAi knockdown of candidate genes identified CG42673 and Tmtc2, whose knockdown increased consumption across sexes and diets and was reproduced in independent experiments. Together, these findings show that natural genetic variation contributes substantially to diet-dependent feeding and identify candidate regulators of sugar-based food consumption in Drosophila.
papers.translated_summary: 饮食与遗传背景相互作用影响食物摄入，然而依赖饮食的摄食行为的遗传基础仍知之甚少。本研究利用全基因组关联分析（GWAS）探究黑腹果蝇中糖依赖性食物摄入的遗传调控。采用Con-Ex（摄入-排泄）测定法，对176个果蝇遗传参考面板（DGRP）品系在低糖和高糖食物上的摄食量进行了定量。果蝇表现出补偿性摄食，即摄入低糖食物多于高糖食物，且该行为在各基因型间基本保持一致。此外，各品系间摄食量的大小和总摄入量存在数倍差异，广义遗传力在性别和饮食间为0.53至0.66。对六种性别和饮食特异性表型的关联分析鉴定出161个变异，映射到118个候选基因，这些基因在两种饮食条件间几乎没有共享位点，表明两种食物上的摄入在很大程度上受独立的遗传控制。对候选基因的RNAi敲低鉴定出CG42673和Tmtc2，其敲低在性别和饮食间均增加摄食量，并在独立实验中得到重复。综上，这些发现表明自然遗传变异对依赖饮食的摄食有实质性贡献，并鉴定了果蝇中糖类食物摄入的候选调控因子。

papers.title: Actin pool controls the scaling of dynamic actin networks
papers.translated_title: 肌动蛋白库控制动态肌动蛋白网络的尺度
papers.author: Cantat, A.
papers.summary: Scaling is a fundamental property of living systems, allowing cells to match the size of their internal components to their volume. The size and shape of cells depend largely on the actin cytoskeleton, whose dynamic self-assembling structures are central to this adaptation. Yet how they self-assemble in a volume-dependent manner remains unresolved. To address this question, we used a biomimetic system consisting of beads propelled by actin polymerization in microwells of different volumes, which allowed us to work with a limited and defined number of components. This approach enabled the first reconstitution, from purified proteins, of dynamic cytoskeletal structures that adapt to the volume of their environment. The scalability of these structures depends on how strongly they deplete monomers from a shared pool, and tuning the disassembly rate is sufficient to shift their scaling regime. Scaling principles also hold for multiple competing structures, with greater competition imposing stronger constraints on the monomer pool. Together, these results establish a mechanistic framework in which a structure's capacity to adapt is set by how much it draws down shared resources as it grows, a principle that may extend to other intracellular structures that scale with the cells that build them.
papers.translated_summary: 尺度缩放是生命系统的基本属性，使细胞能够使其内部组分的尺寸与自身体积相匹配。细胞的大小和形状在很大程度上取决于肌动蛋白细胞骨架，其动态自组装结构是这种适应的核心。然而，它们如何以体积依赖的方式自组装仍未得到解决。为解决这一问题，我们使用了一种仿生系统，该系统由在不同体积微孔中通过肌动蛋白聚合驱动的珠子组成，使我们能够使用数量有限且确定的组分进行研究。这种方法首次实现了从纯化蛋白质出发，重建能够适应其环境体积的动态细胞骨架结构。这些结构的可缩放性取决于它们从共享单体池中耗竭单体的强度，而调节解聚速率足以改变其缩放机制。缩放原理同样适用于多个相互竞争的结构，竞争越激烈对单体池的约束越强。总之，这些结果建立了一个机制框架，其中结构的适应能力由其生长过程中汲取共享资源的多少决定，这一原理可能推广到其他随构建它们的细胞而缩放的细胞内结构。
